IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Friday 6 November
Winds: North to northwesterly about 10 knots becoming westerly in the morning then increasing to 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning south to southeasterly during the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Southeasterly below 10 knots tending easterly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then tending northeasterly during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system over the Bight extends a ridge over Tasmania ahead of a cold front that moves across the state today. The front is followed by a cold southwesterly wind flow which will persist on Saturday. Another high pressure system moves close to Tasmania on Sunday, drifting southeast from Monday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Friday 6 November
Winds: Northwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the day. Winds turning westerly in the morning.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: West to southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail during this afternoon and evening.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending south to southwesterly during the day. Winds reaching up to 25 knots inshore during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: South to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy.
